input.title: ci: wire up the ai-review caller

files.patch:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/ai-review.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+name: ai-review
+on:
+  pull_request_target:
+    branches: [main]
+jobs:
+  review:
+    uses: some-org/ci-toolkit/.github/workflows/ai-review.yml@0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
+    with:
+      toolkit_ref: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
+    secrets: inherit

note: Isolated defect: secrets: inherit hands every repo secret to the reusable workflow instead of the single key it needs. Everything else (trigger, full-SHA pins) is already hardened so only this defect can block.
